derived_info.summary: DCA 221 (Polyglycoldiamine) is a high-performance curing agent for epoxy resin systems that provides exceptional impact resistance, thermal shock resistance, and electrical properties. With its low viscosity and permanent flexibility, DCA 221 is ideal for demanding applications including adhesives, electrical potting and encapsulation, tooling compounds, and troweling compounds. The product offers excellent adhesion to metals and maintains superior electrical characteristics up to 60°C, making it particularly valuable for moderate temperature electrical service applications. Comprehensive formulation data shows performance across castings, flexible compounds, flooring applications, and adhesives with detailed electrical property comparisons.

personas.sales_summary: DCA 221 delivers premium performance in high-impact epoxy applications with built-in flexibility and excellent electrical properties. Key selling points include superior steel-to-steel and aluminum-to-aluminum adhesion, low temperature thermal shock resistance, and versatile application across adhesives, potting compounds, and coatings. The product's light color and low viscosity provide processing advantages, while its proven electrical performance to 60°C opens opportunities in electrical and electronic markets. Multiple formulation examples demonstrate versatility from high-impact castings to flexible compounds and flooring applications.
personas.technical_summary: DCA 221 is a polyglycoldiamine curing agent (CAS 4246-51-9) with specific gravity 1.000-1.020 g/cc, viscosity 9.5-15.8 cps at 25°C, and flash point 331°F. Provides 98.0% min purity with amine equivalent 8.60-9.16 MEQ/g. Formulations achieve flexural strengths up to 12,800 psi, tensile strengths to 8,880 psi, and Izod impact values of 1.5+ ft-lb/in. Electrical properties include dielectric strength up to 517 V/mil and volume resistivity >6x10⁷ megohm-cm at 23°C. Comprehensive comparison data shows superior performance vs commercial diethylene triamine in electrical applications with detailed dissipation factor measurements.
